kpis.description_fr: OCG : capital généré par opérations courantes, hors marché et items uniques. Hero KPI insurer, finance le dividende.
kpis.description_en: OCG: capital generated by ongoing operations, ex-market and one-offs. Insurer hero KPI, funds dividends.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio Solvency II : capital éligible / SCR. Exigence >100%, cible Aegon 150-200%, KPI prudentiel central.
kpis.description_en: Solvency II ratio: own funds / SCR. Requirement >100%, Aegon target 150-200%, central prudential KPI.

kpis.description_fr: VNB segment US (Transamerica) : valeur actualisée des contrats vendus dans l'année. Driver croissance moyen-long terme.
kpis.description_en: US segment (Transamerica) VNB: present value of contracts sold during the year. Medium-long term growth driver.

kpis.description_fr: Encours pension UK Workplace : KPI Aegon UK, croissance auto-enrolment + transferts. Segment growth phase.
kpis.description_en: UK Workplace pension AUM: Aegon UK KPI, auto-enrolment + transfers growth. Growth-phase segment.

kpis.description_fr: Free cash flow remonté de subs vers holding. Détermine capacité de dividende + buyback de la holding.
kpis.description_en: Free cash flow upstreamed from subsidiaries to holding. Determines holding dividend + buyback capacity.

kpis_story.description_fr: Cession 2023-2024 portefeuille legacy US variable annuities et fixed annuities à Wilton Re / Athene. Libère ~$1.4Md capital, accélère retour aux actionnaires.
kpis_story.description_en: 2023-2024 disposal of legacy US variable annuities and fixed annuities block to Wilton Re / Athene. Frees up ~$1.4B capital, accelerates shareholder returns.
